$schema_doc: Placement constraints for the DRV8871 bell ringer cluster (U2 + R2 + C54 + C55). The DRV8871 VM pin must have tight HF bypass and a moderate bulk cap per datasheet SLVSDA2 §9.2 Fig 11. Run `python3 hardware/pcb/v2/tools/check_ringer_placement.py`.

constraints.rationale: DRV8871 VM HF bypass. Must be as close as possible to pin 5 per datasheet §10.1 layout guidelines. 0402 body sits within 3 mm of the SOIC-8 pin pad.
DRV8871 VM bulk reservoir per datasheet §9.2 Fig 11. Electrolytic can be slightly further than the ceramic HF cap; 6 mm is adequate.
ILIM current-trip resistor. 0402 at U2 pin 4. Not critical for placement since ILIM is a DC bias, but keep within 4 mm for tidy routing.
